conversations.question: What is the main topic of this post?
conversations.answer: This post announces the **Annual ECE Research Symposium 2026**, taking place March 15 in the Main Hall. The agenda covers six research tracks ranging from embedded AI to power electronics, with two keynote speakers.

conversations.question: Who can attend the symposium?
conversations.answer: It is open to faculty, graduate students, and invited industry partners. Undergraduates are welcome at the afternoon poster session in the atrium.

conversations.question: Is there a registration fee?
conversations.answer: No. The symposium is free for all university members, but registration is required by Friday so catering numbers can be confirmed.

conversations.question: Where can I park if I am visiting from outside campus?
conversations.answer: Visitor parking is available in **Lot D**, directly across from the Main Hall entrance. The QR code on the signage opens a printable visitor pass.

conversations.question: How do I report a maintenance issue?
conversations.answer: Scan the QR code on the side of any signage display. It opens the IT Services maintenance portal with the device ID pre-filled.

conversations.question: What PPE is required to enter Lab 302?
conversations.answer: A lab coat, safety goggles, and closed-toe shoes are mandatory at all times. Nitrile gloves are required for any chemical handling, and heat-resistant gloves are required when operating the furnace.

conversations.question: What are the lab hours on weekends?
conversations.answer: The lab is closed on Sundays. Saturday hours are 10:00 to 16:00, and only authorised personnel may use the lab outside those windows.

conversations.question: Where is the calibration log stored?
conversations.answer: Calibration logs are stored on the lab share at `\\labshare\ECE302\calibration\<YYYY-MM>\`. Each device has a sub-folder named after its asset tag.

conversations.question: Are there vegan options on Tuesday?
conversations.answer: Yes. Tuesday's dinner — **Lentil Shepherd's Pie** — is fully vegan. Vegan substitutions are also available at the build-your-own bowl station every weekday.

conversations.question: What time does dinner end on weekends?
conversations.answer: Weekend dinner service ends at **20:00**. Weekday dinner runs until 21:00.

conversations.question: Does the Tech Tower Burger contain dairy?
conversations.answer: Yes — the Tech Tower Burger includes a brioche bun (dairy + gluten) and aged cheddar (dairy). A dairy-free version with a sourdough bun and vegan cheese can be ordered at the grill station.

conversations.question: What should I do if I am off-campus when this alert is issued?
conversations.answer: Do not travel to campus. Wait for an `emergency_mode_end` notification (push or SMS) before resuming your normal schedule. Faculty: contact your department chair if you are mid-class.

conversations.question: How long does emergency mode typically last?
conversations.answer: Emergency mode persists until an admin manually clears it via **Admin → Groups**. Hardware-triggered emergencies (button press on a Pi) follow the same rule — they only clear when an admin sets the group's signage state back to NORMAL.
